title: Drink Opener with Pull Tab – Gentle on Your Nails
descriptionHtml:
Open the can without breaking your nails

Getting a bottle cap or pull tab open with your fingers is both awkward and hard on your nails. For many people it's also really difficult.

A little helper in your pocket

This opener lifts the pull tab for you in an instant. It's small, light and has a metal ring so you can keep it on your keychain.

Features

  • Lifts the pull tab without damaging your nails
  • Small and easy to carry
  • Metal ring for your keychain
  • Good for anyone who finds cans hard to open
  • Durable material

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
